request_user:
Fact: target_systems
What to find: Type and nature of AI systems the model can be integrated into (e.g. assistants, agents, RAG, decision support).
Card sections that often contain it: Intended Use, Use Cases, Downstream Use

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Can be used in agentic systems with tool calling (XML JSON tool calls or Python-style tool calls), as an assistive tool, and deployed via OpenAI-compatible API servers (vLLM, SGLang).
quotes: These models should be used as assistive tools rather than definitive sources of information.
You can use vLLM and SGLang to deploy the model in an API compatible with OpenAI format.
